about.label: About Me
about.title: Where the Factory Floor Meets Code & Data
about.lead: I'm a Process Engineer from Barcelona with dual engineering degrees in Mechatronics and Industrial Electronics & Automation, combining theoretical depth with hands-on manufacturing expertise.
about.text1: My career has been shaped by a decade in Spain's most demanding automotive environments — primarily supporting SEAT S.A. and the Volkswagen Group — where I've worked across the full lifecycle of manufacturing: from body-in-white assembly processes and robotic welding systems to automated production cell design and commissioning.
about.text2: Today, at Jordan Group, I lead the industrialization of next-generation welded assemblies integrating resistance spot welding, self-piercing rivets, and structural adhesives — technologies that define modern automotive lightweighting strategies.
about.v1p: Every process I design is built on measurable standards, validated data, and engineering rigor.
about.v2p: I believe every production line has untapped efficiency waiting to be unlocked through systematic analysis.
about.v3p: The best solutions emerge when engineering, quality, maintenance, and production teams speak the same language.
about.location: Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain — Open to relocation & international opportunities
about.text3: Beyond the factory floor, I work hands-on with software and artificial intelligence — developing Python automation, applying large language models and generative AI to engineering workflows, and using data analysis to support better technical decisions. I operate at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, software, and AI.

bullets: Led industrialization of welded assemblies integrating Resistance Spot Welding (RSW), Self-Piercing Rivets (SPR), and structural adhesives for automotive programs
Designed and implemented automated production cells end-to-end: from technical specification and supplier qualification through to commissioning and production handover
Managed supplier selection processes and conducted technical reviews with automation integrators across concurrent industrialization programs
Developed comprehensive process documentation: PFMEAs, control plans, cycle time studies, and work instructions
Supported process validation activities for automotive BIW assembly operations at SEAT's Martorell manufacturing complex
Diagnosed and resolved production-line defects, reducing unplanned downtime and supporting OEE improvement targets
Contributed to continuous improvement projects targeting cycle time reduction and throughput enhancement
Collaborated with cross-functional teams across quality, maintenance, and production planning
Delivered 5 years of specialized process engineering support for SEAT's Body-in-White assembly — Europe's highest-volume automotive body shop
Optimized welding process parameters across multiple production stations, improving weld quality KPIs and reducing scrap
Supported FMEA reviews, measurement system analysis (MSA), and PPAP submissions for new tooling and process changes
Trained operators and technicians on updated welding standards, quality checkpoints, and production procedures
Supported the technical office of the Body Shop maintenance department at one of Europe's largest automotive manufacturing facilities
Assisted in documentation, scheduling, and execution of preventive maintenance programs for automated robotic welding stations
First exposure to large-scale automotive BIW production environments, robotic systems, and engineering workflows

cards.title: Automated Assembly Cell Design & Commissioning
cards.description: End-to-end industrialization of automated production cells integrating RSW, SPR, and structural adhesive technologies. Managed full lifecycle from concept specification to production handover, coordinating with automation integrators across multiple concurrent programs.

cards.title: BIW Welding Process Optimization — SEAT Body Shop
cards.description: Five-year continuous improvement program for SEAT's Body-in-White assembly — one of Europe's highest-volume automotive body shops. Systematic optimization of welding process parameters, quality KPIs, and station efficiency across multiple vehicle platforms.

cards.title: Automotive Production Validation — VW Group
cards.description: Process validation engineering for Volkswagen Group automotive assembly operations at SEAT Martorell. Focused on defect root cause analysis, production troubleshooting, and implementing corrective actions to maintain quality and throughput targets.

cards.title: Smart Manufacturing & Digital Transformation
cards.description: Applying Industry 4.0 principles to manufacturing operations: connected production cells, real-time process monitoring, predictive quality analytics, and digital twin concepts for automated assembly environments.
highlights: Digital twin for assembly cell validation

cards.title: Robotic Welding Systems Integration
cards.description: Technical specification, selection, and integration of robotic welding systems into automotive body assembly lines. Coordinating with robot manufacturers (KUKA, FANUC, ABB) and PLC vendors for complete cell commissioning and production handover.

cards.title: Engineering Research — University of Vic
cards.description: Dual engineering education combining a 4-year Mechatronics Engineering degree with a specialization in Industrial Electronics and Automation. Academic projects bridging mechanical, electronic, and software engineering disciplines.
